title: Lerner 2021 3D audio-tactile PPS boundary
citation: Lerner, F., Tahar, G., Bar, A., Koren, O., & Flash, T. (2021). VR Setup to Assess Peripersonal Space Audio-Tactile 3D Boundaries. Frontiers in Virtual Reality, 2, 644214.
notes: 3D Tune-In/Unity PPS mapping study. The preload catalog expands the paper's twelve virtual source directions into local auditory-only trajectory assets for the dynamic and flat pink-noise source types. The runnable profile captures the reported 144 audio-tactile condition rows; subject-specific body/head scaling and exact Unity/3D Tune-In rendering remain provenance caveats.

reference_parameters.distance_scale: Stimulus timepoints are reported as 0.7-1.7 arm lengths from the chest; profile uses a 70 cm reference arm length, yielding 119, 105, 91, 77, 63, and 49 cm paired with the 5.5 s movement window.
reference_parameters.reported_trial_formula: 144 audio-tactile trials: 12 virtual directions x 2 sound conditions (dynamic looming pink noise and flat stationary pink noise) x 6 arm-length-scaled tactile timepoints x 1 repetition. The profile distributes the pool across four reported experiment blocks.
reference_parameters.apparatus_recreation_policy: The original Unity 2017.4.40 plus 3D Tune-In Toolkit binaural/ambisonic scene is represented by the toolkit's Python SOFA reference renderer using the published 12 spherical source coordinates, 1.2 m start radius, 5.5 s duration, and 22 cm/s speed.
reference_parameters.source_count_caveat: The paper text states four blocks and total 144 trials, but also says 24 trials per block. The runnable profile prioritizes the explicit 144-trial condition matrix and four-block workflow, producing 36 trials per block.
remaining_caveats: subject-specific head circumference and ITD customization are represented by the toolkit's fixed reference listener rather than per-subject 3D Tune-In personalization
subject-specific arm length scaling is represented by a 70 cm reference-arm conversion instead of live participant scaling
the exact original Unity scene, 3D Tune-In runtime behavior, and MATLAB stimulus-generation scripts are not redistributed
the article's 24-trials-per-block wording conflicts with the reported total trial count

provenance.source: Frontiers article reports 12 virtual sound-source positions on a sphere with R = 1.2 m, dynamic and flat sounds, 3D Tune-In Toolkit anechoic rendering, and velocity around 22 cm/s.
Methods report tactile SOA/timepoints at D1-D6 = 0.7, 0.9, 1.1, 1.3, 1.5, and 1.7 arm lengths from the chest; current profile uses a 70 cm reference arm length conversion.
Methods report 144 total experiment trials; the text also says four blocks and 24 trials per block, so the runnable profile preserves four blocks and 144 total rows.

Results report individual 3D PPS boundary polyhedra and no systematic flat-versus-dynamic advantage; Table 2 gives 26 closer flat thresholds and 26 closer dynamic thresholds across valid subject/trajectory pairs.
